scope.zh: 勘测入口、通讯分支、杀与诱两条路线、结束旗标均已核对；墓地考古内容属其他故事。
scope.en: The survey entrance, the communication branch, the kill / lure routes and the closing flag were checked; the graveyard archaeology belongs to other stories.

label.zh: 之后与蒂扬奇完成初次接触时补发
label.en: Sent later, when first contact with the Tiyanki is completed

label.zh: 勘测后：有无与蒂扬奇的通讯
label.en: After the survey: with or without contact with the Tiyanki

note.zh: 勘测完成后若已与蒂扬奇（或其守卫）有通讯则出现 387，否则出现 384“神秘的守卫”，之后初次接触等才会补上后续。
note.en: After the survey 387 appears if the empire can talk to the Tiyanki (or their guardians), otherwise 384 "Mysterious Guardians", with the follow-up coming later through first contact.

note.zh: 消灭守墓者（388）或用诱饵把它们引开（专项 → 389），两者都会设下全局旗标 tiyanki_graveyard_access 并结束事件链。
note.en: Destroy the gravekeepers (388) or lure them away (project -> 389); both set the global flag tiyanki_graveyard_access and end the event chain.

texts.zh:
生活在[tiyanki_graveyard_system.GetName]星系的缇扬奇的行为与该物种的已知行为模式并不一致。缇扬奇通常是迁徙性的，而这群缇扬奇却紧紧守在一颗满是他们同类尸体的行星周围。

它们遮天蔽日的触手阻碍了对这个坟地的研究，除非我们将它们引走或者处置掉，否则进一步的调查难以进行。
texts.en:
The actions of the Tiyanki inhabiting the [tiyanki_graveyard_system.GetName] system do not match known behavior patterns for their species. While Tiyanki are usually nomadic, these herds remain stationed around a planet entirely covered in the carcasses of their own dead.

Attempts to study the burial ground have been hindered by the net of tentacles the Tiyanki have wrapped around the planet, making further research impossible - unless we are willing to displace or dispose of the gravekeepers.

label.zh: 缇扬奇就还挺弱的。宰了它们。
label.en: Tiyanki make easy prey. Eliminate them.

tooltips.zh: 肃清守在[tiyanki_graveyard_system.GetName]的缇扬奇以接近他们的坟场。
tooltips.en: Eliminate the Tiyanki stationed in the [tiyanki_graveyard_system.GetName] to gain access to their burial ground.

label.zh: 在不伤害他们的前提下引走吧。
label.en: Displace the gravekeepers without harming them.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现缇扬奇坟场所在星系的名称。
note.en: In the game, the name of the Tiyanki graveyard system appears here.

notes.zh: 评注：勘测墓地行星（标记 graveyard_site）时，首个人类玩家会设下 tiyanki_graveyard_survey；有通讯则本窗口，无通讯则隐藏事件 galactic_features.386 发 384（events/galactic_features_events.txt:3555-3590）。
notes.en: Commentary: when the graveyard planet (flag graveyard_site) is surveyed the first human player sets tiyanki_graveyard_survey; with communications this window shows, otherwise the hidden galactic_features.386 sends 384 (events/galactic_features_events.txt:3555-3590).

texts.zh: 缇扬奇以气体为食。建造一座气体散播站，我们就能引走那些守在[tiyanki_graveyard_system.GetName]恒星系的缇扬奇，并且接近他们的坟场。
texts.en: Tiyanki feed on gas. By building a gas diffuser station, we may lure out the Tiyanki stationed in the [tiyanki_graveyard_system.GetName] system and gain access to their burial ground.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现缇扬奇坟场所在星系的名称。
note.en: In the game, the name of the Tiyanki graveyard system appears here.

texts.zh: 我们已经在[tiyanki_graveyard_system.GetName]星系完成了缇扬奇诱饵的建设。受到散播装置释放的营养性气体的误导，守墓的兽群被诱惑离开了他们的驻地，允许我们的[Owner.GetScientistPlural]悄悄溜过它们的触手，在不引起注意的情况下接近墓地。
texts.en: The construction of the Tiyanki lure in the [tiyanki_graveyard_system.GetName] system has been completed. Beguiled by the nourishing gases released by the diffuser, the gravekeepers are lured away from their post, allowing our [Owner.GetScientistPlural] to slip through their tentacles and approach the burial ground unnoticed.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现缇扬奇坟场所在星系的名称。
note.en: In the game, the name of the Tiyanki graveyard system appears here.

texts.zh: 在[tiyanki_graveyard_system.GetName]恒星系发现的一颗完全被缇扬奇尸体覆盖了的行星。想研究这一怪异的埋葬地，我们必须先解决它的守墓人。
texts.en: A planet entirely covered in the bodies of dead Tiyanki has been found in the [tiyanki_graveyard_system.GetName] system. In order to study this unusual burial ground, we must first deal with its gravekeepers.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现缇扬奇坟场所在星系的名称。
note.en: In the game, the name of the Tiyanki graveyard system appears here.

texts.zh:
一大群[tiyanki_no_contact.GetName]聚集在一个行星的周边，上面遍布某种外星生命体的尸体。

由于我们对于这些外星实体没有任何信息，我们只能对它们的行为进行猜测。
texts.en:
A large number of [tiyanki_no_contact.GetName] are clustered around a planet covered in the carcasses of some alien life-form.

Having no information on those alien entities, we can only speculate on their behavior.

tooltips.zh: 同[tiyanki_no_contact.GetName]建立第一次接触以了解更多信息。
tooltips.en: Establish first contact with the [tiyanki_no_contact.GetName] to learn more.

label.zh: 之后与蒂扬奇完成初次接触时补发
label.en: Sent later, when first contact with the Tiyanki is completed

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现尚未接触的物种名称。
note.en: In the game, the name of the species not yet contacted appears here.

texts.zh: 在肃清停留在[FromFrom.System.GetName]的缇扬奇之后，我们的[Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural]可以安全地接近墓地，进一步开展研究。
texts.en: Having eliminated the Tiyanki stationed in [FromFrom.System.GetName], our [Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural] can now safely approach the burial ground to conduct their research.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现那个星系的名称。
note.en: In the game, the name of that star system appears here.

notes.zh: 评注：当守墓舰队被歼灭（on_fleet_destroyed_perp）且尚无人取得进入权时触发（common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:1665）。
notes.en: Commentary: fires when the gravekeeper fleet is destroyed (on_fleet_destroyed_perp) and nobody has gained access yet (common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:1665).

summary.text:
# 守墓兽群 / Gravekeepers

> 本文为人工审阅导读（评注），不是游戏原文；原文见阅读器。 / Reviewer guide (commentary), not original game text; the original text is in the reader.

- 分类 Category：C8 银河轶事 / Galactic miscellany
- 来源 Sources：`events/galactic_features_events.txt:3541-3735`; `common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:1665`; `common/special_projects/00_projects_3.txt:1687`
- 审阅 Reviewed：2026-10-13（已审阅 reviewed）

## 如何开始 How it starts

勘测蒂扬奇墓地行星（on_survey_planet → 386）：有通讯得 387“守墓兽群”，无通讯得 384“神秘的守卫”。

Surveying the Tiyanki graveyard planet (on_survey_planet -> 386): with communications 387 "Gravekeepers", without 384 "Mysterious Guardians".

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

387 两个选项：消灭守墓者（创建兴趣点，击毁守卫舰队后 388“亵渎的坟墓”）或把它们移走而不伤害（专项 TIYANKI_LURE，建气体扩散站诱饵 → 389“美味诱饵”）；两条路都以 tiyanki_graveyard_access 结束事件链“蒂扬奇墓地”。

387 offers two options: eliminate the gravekeepers (a point of interest is made; after the guard fleet is destroyed, 388 "Desecrated Grave") or displace them harmlessly (special project TIYANKI_LURE, a gas-diffuser bait -> 389 "Tasty Bait"); both end the event chain "Tiyanki Graveyard" with tiyanki_graveyard_access.

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

消灭 / 诱离（诱离只对非嗜杀帝国开放）。

Eliminate / lure (lure is closed to homicidal empires).

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

无。

None.

原先的 event-galactic-features-386 与 -388 并入本故事。

The former event-galactic-features-386 and -388 are merged here.
